build_transformer_config: build a TransformerConfig dataclass with num_heads, num_layers, key_size, mlp_hidden_size, and dropout_rate
create_transformer_stack: create a Transformer stack module that applies multi-head attention and MLP blocks with residual connections
run_transformer_forward: run a Transformer forward pass on input embeddings with a causal mask and optional dropout
compile_transformer_model: compile a full Transformer model with token embeddings, positional embeddings, and unembedding layers
get_transformer_outputs: get TransformerOutput containing layer outputs, residuals, attention logits, and final output embeddings
